title: Registration Exemptions & Offerings

sections.heading: Securities Act of 1933 — Purpose
items: Regulates NEW ISSUES (primary market) — full & fair disclosure
Issuer files S-1 → 20-day cooling-off → effective date
SEC does NOT approve/disapprove — disclaimer required

sections.heading: Exempt ISSUERS (issuer-based exemption)
items: National & state BANKS (NOT bank holding companies)
Common carriers (e.g., railroad equipment trust certs)

sections.heading: Exempt SECURITIES (issue-based exemption)
items: Commercial paper, bankers' acceptances — maturity ≤ 270 days
Insurance policies & FIXED annuities (NOT variable — variables = securities)

items.Investor Limits: Non-accredited: max 10% of greater of income/net worth

sections.heading: Accredited Investor (Rule 501) — Thresholds
items: INCOME: $200K individual OR $300K joint — past 2 yrs & expected current yr
Insiders: officers, directors, 10%+ shareholders of issuer
Licensed: Series 7, 65, or 82 holders in good standing
Need to meet only ONE criterion

sections.heading: Rule 147 — Intrastate Requirements
items: Issuer HQ in state + 100% of buyers are state residents
Must meet ONE 80% test: 80% income / 80% assets / 80% proceeds used in state, OR majority of employees in state
If BD underwrites — BD must be in-state
Resale to nonresidents PROHIBITED for 6 months after purchase

sections.heading: Rule 144A — QIB Market
items: QIB = institution that owns/invests min $100,000,000 in securities (discretionary)
Allows resale of restricted/private placement securities among QIBs
No holding period for QIB-to-QIB sales

common_traps: Bank securities are exempt BUT bank HOLDING COMPANY securities are NOT exempt
Fixed annuities = exempt; VARIABLE annuities/VUL = MUST register (separate account = security)
Net worth for accredited EXCLUDES primary residence — don't include the house
Reg D 506(b) allows up to 35 non-accredited investors BUT NO general solicitation; 506(c) allows advertising but ALL buyers must be accredited & verified
Commercial paper exempt only if maturity ≤ 270 days — 271+ days requires registration
Rule 147 resale restriction = 6 months to nonresidents (not 12); all purchasers must be residents (100%, not 80%)
